nodes.label: Prior session — Round displayed award progress percentage — PR #440 MERGED `5d0cb71` Demo-surfaced cleanup / bug-fix; **frontend-only, display-formatting**. The agent Awards tab rendered the awards engine's `progressPercent` as raw floats (`13.333333333333334%`, `9.538461538461538%`); the manager Awards tab shared the same latent bug (only `0%` read clean because 0 is round). Root cause (Phase 0): `awardsEngine.js:33` computes `progressPercent` as a clamped raw float (`Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (value/threshold)*100))`) and the render sites displayed it verbatim. **Fix:** a single shared `formatAwardPct(pct) = Math.round(Number(pct)||0)` in `src/utils/formatters.js`, applied at every raw-float display site: `awardPrimitives.jsx` (`AwardDonut` `{percent}%` label · `AwardCard` state pill `${progressPercent}%` · `AwardCard` big percent) and the **inline-duplicated copies** in `AgentAwardsPanel.jsx` (same three). Both the shared module and the inline dupes were fixed because of the known `awardPrimitives` ↔ `AgentAwardsPanel` duplication (a one-site fix leaves the agent panel broken) — that dedup FU stays **open and untouched**, with a cross-reference note added. **Phase-0 enumeration** also confirmed the sites that were already rounded and needed no change: `MonthlyBonusHero.fillPercent`, `AwardDrillDrawer` criteria `pct`, kiosk `AwardsWatchPanel` (own `Math.round` + `PctDisplay`), PDF `AwardRow`, `AwardMedalCard.primaryCriterionLine` (renders criterion current/target, `.toFixed(0)` for `%`; also now an orphan), and HomeV2 `MiniDonut` (SVG arc only, no numeric label). Manager award cards render through the shared `AwardCard`/`AwardDrillDrawer`, so the `awardPrimitives` edit fixes them too.
